description: Cthreshold byte-flip mutation fixtures: 144 single-byte-flip mutations of a baseline 2-of-3 Cthreshold signature. Covers the root challenge zone (0-23), polynomial bytes zone (24-47), and scalar-z zone (48-143). The verifier must return false or throw VerifyError on every entry — flipping any byte invalidates either a challenge, polynomial coefficient, or response.
